protected_invariants: malformed_output must never produce a substantive finding
abstention must propagate as escalate, not as rejection
unsigned_receipt must be rejected in enforcement mode
stale_artifact_hash must be rejected regardless of signature validity

gate_outcome.reason: All provider seats unreachable — no API keys configured and network unreachable.

operator_receipt.reason: Hot-patch urgency; provider outage confirmed; deterministic validator passed; risk accepted.

expected_behavior.rationale: Infrastructure-limited acceptance receipts are advisory-only. Enforcement mode must reject unsigned receipts. The 'unavailable' status must propagate as a distinct outcome, not as 'passed' or 'rejected'. AC-04 and protected behavior: provider outage never becomes substantive plan rejection.

fixtures.notes: Tests the boundary between advisory acceptance (degraded gate, operator override) and enforcement eligibility (requires signed receipt). Verifies that 'unavailable' is a named ConsensusDecision value, not an error or false rejection.

expected_behavior.rationale: Signed override with valid key_id, matching artifact_sha256, and non-expired timestamp must be accepted in enforcement mode. expected_behavior.error: receipt artifact_sha256 does not match current plan content hash
expected_behavior.rationale: The plan was revised after the receipt was issued; the artifact_sha256 in the receipt (4b227...) no longer matches the current plan content hash (9d5ed...). Verifier must reject stale receipts in both enforcement and advisory modes. AC-06: every receipt is bound to a canonical artifact SHA-256 hash. AC-08: stale-receipt rejection rate is a tracked metric.

fixtures.notes: Tests the hash-binding invariant. Even a validly signed receipt for a prior version of the plan must be rejected. The plan gate must canonicalize the current plan content and compare SHA-256 before checking any other receipt field.

missing_signature.error: enforcement rejects unsigned receipt: missing signature field

unknown_key_id.error: enforcement fails closed: key_id 'plan-gate-key-UNKNOWN' not in trust store

expired_receipt.error: receipt expired at 2026-07-17T20:59:00Z; current time is after expiry

expected_behavior.rationale: AC-06: enforcement rejects invalid, expired, unauthorized, or artifact-mismatched override receipts. AC-19: receipt verification passes current/overlap Ed25519 keys and rejects unknown, revoked, expired, malformed, or missing trust material without exposing private key data. The verifier must fail closed when trust material is absent or invalid.

fixtures.notes: Three sub-cases test the three most common receipt invalidity scenarios. The trust store is provided via PLAN_GATE_TRUSTED_PUBLIC_KEYS environment variable. Missing or invalid trust material must fail closed in enforcement, not fail open.
